component.name: PkgDeck
component.summary: All your package managers in one app

description.p: Search, install, update, and clean up software from every package manager on your computer. PkgDeck works with APT, Flatpak, Snap, Homebrew, developer tools, container images, and firmware updates, and includes the pkd command-line tool.
Fixes for opened files, Homebrew Casks and KDE.

ul.li: An opened file for something already installed offers Update, or for Flatpak, Reinstall or Downgrade, instead of Install
Going to another page leaves an opened file's page
Flatpak links open in PkgDeck on KDE
Homebrew Casks searches no longer fail on casks with no version for this system
Header buttons drop their labels before covering the page title
